item.title: Ware’s big night helps Heat overcome Adebayo foul trouble in 126-110 rout of Nets
item.description: On many other nights, the Miami Heat might have reached the point of peril. Against the Brooklyn Nets, adversity merely proved to be an inconvenience Thursday for Erik Spoelstra's team.
